snippet.title: Beyond Words | Basant Namdev | Zepto Cafe Special Partners
snippet.description:
Meet Basant Namdev, a Café Partner at Zepto Café, whose journey is all about resilience and inclusion. Growing up deaf, he faced rejection while searching for jobs, but with his sister’s support he never gave up. Today, he thrives at Zepto Café,  cooking Maggi, learning to make chai, and even teaching his colleagues sign language so they can connect better. His dream is simple yet powerful: for everyone to learn sign language, so he can communicate with the whole world.
At Zepto Cafe, every chef and packer plays a vital role in delivering not just meals, but joy, comfort, and care to our customers. Among them, we are proud to have a few specially-abled individuals who inspire us every day with their resilience, dedication, and heart. And Beyond Words honours these stories.
